outcome: Utilization of complete postnatal care services
cohort: The study included 262 women who gave birth during the previous 12 months in district Sargodha and district Mianwali, Punjab, Pakistan.
finding: A low practice of complete postnatal care utilization was observed, with only 26.3% of women receiving all four recommended visits, and its utilization was significantly associated with various socioeconomic and delivery-related factors.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed a significant association with the utilization of complete postnatal care.
